messages:
tom: hey folks, first week Q: where do I get a sandbox api key vs a hosted/prod key? also what's the sandbox rate limit so I can run a small smoke test without burning credits?

lee: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-created in Console -> Sandbox (look for "Your sandbox key"). Hosted/prod keys are under Console -> API Keys and require an org admin to create.

devex-bot: Sandbox details: new hires get $25 promo credits + a 30k token/month soft quota. Rate-limits: 12 reqs/sec per key with short bursts allowed up to ~48 reqs/sec. For transient load tests request a temporary testing key via https://go/redwood-support.

security: Note: any hosted key access to customer-data scopes requires an approval email to security@redwood.com and an audit log entry.

lee: quick dev tip: put keys in env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY). Don't store in repo. For CI use secrets manager. Use a staging org for large-scale experiments.

tom: thanks! one more: who can approve a sandbox quota bump?

devex-bot: Ping @ops or open a ticket and select "Sandbox quota increase". For >200k tokens/month we typically request a short justification and an ops lead sign-off.

tom: awesome, saved. I ran the example curl and it's working.

lee: nice. example curl for sandbox:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"test"}'
```
lee: ping me if you need a staging account set up.

tom: will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
